purpose: Freeze deterministic sensor search and pairing rules for all parallel blind windows before meteorological ranking is executed or any parallel window is selected.

anchor_time_semantics.anchor: blind meteorological local calendar date D selected only by the separately preregistered meteorological ranking contract

sentinel_1_grd.reason_for_envelope: Three nominal 12-day same-satellite repeat cycles provide fixed redundancy without using Cashahuacra timing or any outcome.
sentinel_1_grd.pre_interval: D-36 through D-1 local calendar days
sentinel_1_grd.post_interval: D+1 through D+36 local calendar days
sentinel_1_grd.polarization_rule: VV must be present in both acquisitions; additional polarizations do not invalidate a pair.
pair_ordering: smallest total absolute temporal distance to local date D

landsat_c2_l2.reason_for_envelope: Three nominal 16-day Landsat repeat cycles provide a fixed cloud-robust search envelope without using known outcomes.
landsat_c2_l2.pre_interval: D-48 through D-1 local calendar days
landsat_c2_l2.post_interval: D+1 through D+48 local calendar days
landsat_c2_l2.qa_rule: Compute QA_PIXEL strict-clear fraction inside the frozen basin AOI for every catalog candidate before pair choice; aerosol is diagnostic only.
strict_clear_pair_ordering: largest minimum of pre and post AOI strict-clear fraction
smallest total absolute temporal distance to local date D
landsat_c2_l2.reason_no_threshold_here: A1 records availability and deterministically chooses the best same-platform/WRS bracketing pair; any A4 minimum common-clear-support gate must be separately preregistered before optical differences are computed.

copernicus_dem_glo30.rule: Freeze every exact tile intersecting the frozen basin geometry by byte count and SHA-256 before A2; transport failures remain UNKNOWN_NOT_MISSING.

smap.rule: Assess temporal product availability independently after the blind date is selected. Before mission coverage or when no scientifically usable product exists, record explicit MISSING_FOR_WINDOW; authentication/transport failures remain UNKNOWN_NOT_MISSING; never impute zero or climatology.
